verdict.rationale: Blaxel docs describe agents provisioning sandboxes via a skill/API with zero code, exposing each sandbox as an MCP server so agents can execute code via tool calls, and scale-to-zero/teardown behavior after inactivity — covering provision, execute, read results, and teardown end-to-end without human intervention. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a full agentic loop and explicit documentation of an agent reading back execution results programmatically.
